hash_boundary: Hashes checked after the focused tests and CLI help completed, before any model/service launch. This receipt is not a model or runtime worker validation.

focused_tests.scope: Real LocalSTT pending/completion lifecycle with stub engine, injected sleep barrier, real SDK AudioOutput chain; no models, services, RTC network or native inference.

checks: Returned nonempty and empty text remain pending throughout injected hold; engine observation finishes before hold starts; completion emitted afterward.
Native-await and delivery-hold cancellation propagate and report cancelled, never confirmed empty; context does not leak to later calls.
Engine failure identity is preserved and receives no added delay.
Each LocalSTT object binds once, concurrent task contexts remain separate, later condition change does not alter the old binding, and repeated recognitions in a delayed case all retain delay.
Warmup, normal and nested whole-span retranscription, and inherited child-task engine calls are excluded.
Unknown case, mismatched delay or boolean delay fail before backend invocation.
Baseline public chain delegates PCM, playback events, pause, resume, flush and clear without evaluating recognition state.
CLI help completes without main model imports; method and dependency Python AST parse.

independent_read_only_review.finding: No concrete adapter ordering/context flaw. Same-task/engine scope, post-observed-native delay, whole-span reset, unchanged errors/cancellation and baseline chaining checked.
independent_read_only_review.suite_requirement: Must not change condition file until preceding room departure is verified. Condition is deliberately bound at first recognition, not inferred from packet payload or model output.

limits: Injected sleep barrier checks requested duration=5 but does not measure five seconds of actual elapsed waiting; live execution remains pending.
Only baseline output policy differs between arms; both use current LocalSTT pending counters and shared SDK false-interruption logging.
Exact runtime condition bytes/hash and get_job_context room are retained once per LocalSTT. Serial suite transition log and verified room departure remain runner responsibilities.
All diagnostic rows remain buffered until launcher exit. Abrupt process termination can leave reports unavailable.
No production, historical/frozen method, configuration, raw audio or git staging edits were performed.
